topic: Set it once with CLAUDE.md: a note Claude Code reads every time you start
post:
Tired of telling Claude Code the same things every time? 🔁
Write them down once, in a file called CLAUDE.md.

What it is:
CLAUDE.md is a simple text note you keep in your project folder. Claude's help center says Claude Code reads it at the start of every session in that folder. 📝

So you set your preferences once, and every session starts on the right foot.

How to start 👇
1️⃣ Open Claude Code in your project folder
2️⃣ Type /init and Claude drafts a CLAUDE.md for you
3️⃣ Read it, and fix anything that's wrong
4️⃣ Add your own rules in plain English

Example lines:
"Explain changes in plain English. I'm not a developer."
"Never delete files. Ask first."
"Save new files in the 'output' folder." ✅

Good habits, per Claude's own docs:
✂️ Keep it short
🔄 Update it when Claude keeps making the same mistake
⚠️ It's guidance, not a lock. Claude follows it, but it's not a hard rule.

📌 Claude Code is included with Claude's Pro and Max plans.

Why it matters:
The best automation isn't fancy. It's not having to repeat yourself. 💡

What's one rule you'd put in your CLAUDE.md? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
